description: OP_SELFTEST (P6e D13; pq-zether.md 9.1): input exactly 06 00000000, output keccak256(kat_digest || u8(pqzl_valid) || u8(pqzl_invalid) || u8(pqzh_valid) || u8(pqzh_invalid)); kat_digest = keccak256(a_digest || keccak256(pk) || keccak256(u || v) || M (16 bytes) || keccak256(fft) || u8(fft_ok)): a_digest = matrix.json a_keccak; pk = KeyGen(seed_key); u || v = Enc(pk, digits(msg_value), seed_enc); M = Dec; fft = Ligero's forward FFT over the 1,634-point domain (omega = 3^((q-1)/1634)) of a_i = (i^2 * 0x9E3779B9 + 1) mod q, 6-byte BE elements, fft_ok = the inverse gives a back. The four results: the precompile path on the REGISTER statement (opTag || id || keccak256(SCAAS-PQZ-SELFTEST-V1) || pk) with the REGISTER proof of each id (rnd32 = 0x53 x 32), and the same proof with the last message byte flipped (statement byte 95 bit 0). Computed by pqz-ffi (selftest::report, the hash also through pqz_precompile on 06 00000000), whose build.rs compiles in these REGISTER proofs. This set's build has no PQZH (until plan 5h Task 8c): fft is empty (n 0, ok 0) and both PQZH results are 0.
